name: Arrow-Key Minimal
tagline: One bold mono-colour background per slide, 160px headlines, short accent bars and mono labels

palette.description: Eight alternating solid or gradient backgrounds: indigo, cream, crimson, emerald, slate, violet, white, charcoal

typography.style: Huge sans headlines with JetBrains Mono labels

best_for: Talks with a few strong statements and little imagery, where colour changes pace the story. Suits keynotes and speeches with one idea per slide.
